name: Better Business Bureau
description: bbb.org business directory: search businesses by name/category and location across the US and Canada with rating and accreditation filters; read a full business profile with BBB letter grade, accreditation status and dates, complaint and review summaries, alerts and licences; list published complaints with business responses; resolve a pasted bbb.org URL or id to its canonical identity. Reads the server-rendered page state live on every call; bbb.org sits behind a Cloudflare managed challenge which the runner's solver clears.

tools.name: Complaints
tools.description: You need the complaint detail behind a business's complaint counts, filtered by status (answered, resolved, unanswered) or type.

options.name: complaint_type
options.about: bbb.org complaint type slug (see `available_filters.type` of a previous page).

options.name: id
options.about: BBB identity `<bbbId>-<businessId>` as it appears at the end of the profile URL (e.g. 0825-1000223803). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,12}$.

options.name: url
options.about: A pasted bbb.org business profile URL, or any of its sub pages (/complaints, /customer-reviews, /leave-a-review). Exactly one of `id` or `url`.

response.about: Published customer complaints for one business from its bbb.org complaints tab, newest first, 10 per page, with complaint type, status, date, text and the business/consumer response thread, plus the status/type filter counts bbb.org offers and the profile's closed-complaint summary.

fields.name: date
fields.about: YYYY-MM-DD or null.

fields.name: id
fields.about: bbb.org complaint id `<bbbId>_<businessId>_<complaintId>`.

fields.name: text
fields.about: Consumer's complaint text as published (bbb.org masks personal data with asterisks).

responses.author: business
responses.text_html:
Hello,

I'm Naveen from Amazon.com. I'm writing in response to a complaint filed on your behalf by the Better Business Bureau BBB - I've provided the BBB with a copy of this message.

I'm very sorry to hear about the frustrating experience that you've had recently with our team regarding your order ID # *******************. I can certainly understand your request and upon checking, I see that refund of $32.06 was issued on September 11, 2026.

Thanks for your patience and understanding in this regard.

items.text: Hello,I'm reaching out to escalate a ridiculous runaround I've been getting regarding a $32.06 refund credit that was explicitly promised to me for order #***-4226310-7460223.Two different Amazon support agents put their commitment in writing and confirmed the credit. But instead of honoring what your staff promised, your social media and email teams have completely ignored the proof, claimed it's a "misunderstanding," and started spamming me with blind, automated scripts asking for info I've already provided multiple times.  One of the agents even told me that the refund was issued and sent a confirmation email but it never arrived into my account balance.I have attached the screenshots proving the promised credit, the agent saying they issued the credit, and me being denied the refund I was promised.  Please issue the $32.06 refund that was promised to my account gift card balance.

tools.name: Profile
tools.description: You have a BBB `id` (from search or resolve) or a pasted bbb.org profile URL and need ratings, accreditation and complaint summary figures.

options.name: id
options.about: BBB identity `<bbbId>-<businessId>` as it appears at the end of the profile URL (e.g. 0825-1000223803). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,12}$.

options.name: url
options.about: A pasted bbb.org business profile URL, or any of its sub pages (/complaints, /customer-reviews, /leave-a-review). Exactly one of `id` or `url`.

response.about: The full bbb.org business profile for one business: names, website and phone, categories, BBB letter grade with reasons, accreditation status and dates, file-opened / started / incorporated dates, address and coordinates, entity type, years in business, complaint counts (closed in the last 3 years and 12 months), review count and average stars, alerts such as government actions, licences and management.

fields.name: alerts
fields.about: Government actions, advertising reviews and other BBB alerts, verbatim HTML.

fields.name: attribution
fields.about: Attribution string to display with the data.

fields.name: bbb_id
fields.about: Four-digit id of the local BBB that holds the file.

fields.name: business_id
fields.about: Numeric business id assigned by BBB.

fields.name: complaints_summary
fields.about: Complaint counts as bbb.org shows them; null when the page omits a figure.

fields.name: employees
fields.about: Employee count when bbb.org shows a positive number; null otherwise (0 means unknown on the site).

fields.name: id
fields.about: Stable bbb.org identity `<bbbId>-<businessId>`, the trailing part of every profile URL.

fields.name: management
fields.about: Business management / principal contacts as bbb.org lists them (names and titles only).

fields.name: observed_at_ms
fields.about: Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC) when this program read the page. Live read on every call, no cache.

fields.name: phone
fields.about: Primary business phone as listed.

fields.name: source_url
fields.about: Canonical bbb.org profile URL.

fields.name: terms_url
fields.about: bbb.org terms of use governing this public data.

fields.name: website
fields.about: Business website as listed.

licenses.agency: Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners

reasons: Customer Reviews are not used in the calculation of the BBB Letter Grade Rating.
rating.scale: BBB letter grade A+ to F; NR = not rated

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Start here to find a business and its `id` for profile / complaints / resolve, or to list businesses in a category and place.

options.name: category_id
options.about: Restrict to one BBB type-of-business id (`filter_category`), taken from a previous search's `filters.categories`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}-[0-9]{3}$.

options.name: country
options.about: Market to search: bbb.org serves the United States and Canada.

options.name: location
options.about: City and state/province (`Austin, TX`), or a ZIP / postal code (bbb.org `find_loc`). Omit for a nationwide search.

options.name: min_rating
options.about: Minimum BBB letter grade (`filter_ratings`): A means A and above.

options.name: page
options.about: 1-based result page of 15 items; bbb.org exposes at most 15 pages per query.

options.name: query
options.about: Business name or category words (bbb.org `find_text`). Required unless `category_id` is given.

options.name: state
options.about: Restrict to one state/province code (`filter_state`). Pattern: ^[A-Z]{2}$.

response.about: Find businesses on bbb.org by name or category words and an optional city/state or postal code, with the site's own filters (accredited only, minimum letter grade, category id, state, radius) and sort. Returns 15 items per page with BBB identity, canonical profile URL, letter grade, accreditation flag, categories, address, phones and service areas, plus the filter values bbb.org offers.

fields.name: accreditation_status
fields.about: bbb.org's accreditation status text when present (e.g. revoked).

fields.name: address_id
fields.about: The location (address) id component of `result_id`.

fields.name: bbb_id
fields.about: Four-digit id of the local BBB that holds the file.

fields.name: business_id
fields.about: Numeric business id assigned by BBB.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.about: Distance from the searched location in miles when bbb.org computes it; null otherwise.

fields.name: id
fields.about: Stable bbb.org identity `<bbbId>-<businessId>`, the trailing part of every profile URL.

fields.name: is_accredited
fields.about: bbb.org `bbbMember`: BBB Accredited Business.

fields.name: location_url
fields.about: bbb.org page for this specific address of a multi-location business, when the row is a secondary location.

fields.name: logo_url
fields.about: Logo image URL on m.bbb.org (URL only, never stored).

fields.name: name
fields.about: Business name with bbb.org's <em> highlight markup removed.

fields.name: out_of_business_status
fields.about: bbb.org's out-of-business status when present; numeric source codes are preserved as strings without inferring their meaning.

fields.name: phones
fields.about: Business phone numbers as displayed.

fields.name: rating
fields.about: BBB letter grade as shown (A+ … F, or NR); null when the page shows none.

fields.name: rating_score
fields.about: bbb.org's internal numeric rating score (0-100 scale) when exposed; null otherwise.

fields.name: result_id
fields.about: bbb.org's per-row id `<bbbId>_<businessId>_<addressId>`; unique within a result. A multi-location business appears once per address with the same `id`.

fields.name: source_url
fields.about: Canonical bbb.org profile URL.
